# Cycle93 Leo rescue result fixtures

`rq_leo_task-natural-entry.json` and `rq_leo_task-natural-paid.json` are byte-identical copies of cycle92 survival seed921137 attempt01, n373 choice2 (lights). Original filenames are `scene-rq_leo_task-entry-372.json` and `scene-rq_leo_task-result-372.json`. Exact source paths/SHA are pinned in baseline.json and SHA256.json. The natural clock is DAY8 min782.6→857.6. No fresh journey was run to create these fixtures.

Three `*-controlled-paid.json` files were captured **before cycle93 registration** using that entry with explicit fixture-only DAY8 10:00, food30/water30/fuel50/scrap40/fatigue10/van90 and winch=true so all three actual choices can be exercised. They are controlled continuations, not natural choices or independent players. All outcomes have p1. Baseline stores original definition, entry turns, selected outcome text/reader/chips/effects/state/reading and the prior keys follow/wade/follow. Neighbor rq_leo_follow and ev_leo_solo definitions/readers/effects/keys are pinned to detect accidental global key replacement.

Natural and controlled paid readers must retain their recorded words, original selected scene, history and receipt with replay.applied=false. `view-only` is a synthetic recovery form keeping the recorded view while removing reading. `text-only` explicitly deletes view/reading/authoredView: it cannot prove recovery of deleted historical frame data. These old untimed receipts retain their prose/receipt and original untimed registry fallback; no fictitious historical scene is reconstructed. Fresh timed receipts before their first outcome capture are tested separately against the result clock. Neither fixture mode is counted as new play.

The original controlled baseline used food30/water30 above capacity. It is retained verbatim as historical controlled evidence. Only the exact authored/effect and neighbor baseline comparison deliberately reproduces those original conditions; it never asserts that over-capacity state survives load. New before/after-view and paid clock-boundary tests use20/20 within capacity. Replayed chips are compared with the saved receipt (which normalizes empty style to item), while all chip text remains separately exact.
